llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must derive an explicit dirty state for the edit form (for example comparing current input vs last saved value) and only block leaving when that state is dirty.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: isDirty is derived by comparing current input (text) against savedName, and is reset to false on save. The dirty flag correctly reflects unsaved changes.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must intercept native-stack back/remove actions with `usePreventRemove(...)` on the edit screen.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: usePreventRemove is never imported or called anywhere in the submitted code. Native back gestures and hardware back button are not intercepted.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must show an explicit confirmation choice when leaving with unsaved changes and resume on confirm (for example by dispatching `data.action`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Alert.alert is shown on the manual Back button press, but without usePreventRemove the native remove action is never dispatched/resumed via data.action. The confirmation path only covers the custom button, not the native navigation action.
evidence: Alert.alert used in handleBack with Discard calling navigation.goBack()
No data.action dispatch present anywhere in the file

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must allow leaving the edit screen without a confirmation prompt when there are no unsaved changes.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: When isDirty is false, handleBack calls navigation.goBack() directly without showing any confirmation prompt.
